office:text.text:p: I had 100 dogs. They barked loud. I could hear them from far away.
The invitations were written fancily. I could smell the calligraphy classes.
They were actually too fancy. I was intimidated and did not attend the wedding.
Sarah leaned in. “What do you mean you can’t find them?”
